notes.title: Announcement of Regularly Updated Maintenance (EU7) 20250923
notes.content:

notes.title: Kings Call: Infernal Mode "Ascension Tower" Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Warriors,

The path of ascension is about to face its most brutal trial yet!

[b]​Infernal Mode Ascension Tower[/b] is coming soon—higher floors, fiercer enemies, and harsher conditions await those who dare to challenge their limits!

[b]I. Unlock Conditions​[/b]

​Unlocked Floors: [b]Initial release of 25 floors for Infernal Mode[/b].
​Clear Requirement: [b]Must fully clear Normal Mode Ascension Tower once.[/b]
​Entry Cost: Requires [b]「Inferno Tickets」[/b] to challenge.

[b]II. Gameplay Highlights​[/b]

​Extreme Difficulty: Enemies are significantly stronger with deadlier mechanics.
​Layered Trials: New special floor events and restrictions test your adaptability.

[b]III. Exclusive Rewards Preview​[/b]

​Clear Rewards:
▶ Chance to obtain new item: 「Inferno Shards」 (flip-card reward)
▶ Exchange at Tower Store for:
Fire Ruby
Opal Fragment
Advanced Fusion Catalyst
...and other rare rewards!

[b]IV. Pre-Battle Benefits​[/b]

​Launch Gift: Receive 「Inferno Tickets」×5​ via mail after update.

[b]V. Follow-up Activities[/b]

​First Clear Bonus:
▶[b]Every 5 floors cleared → Extra 「Inferno Shards」 +「Solar Chest」​​[/b]

The ultimate trial begins now—​
Will you be the conqueror who crushes all, or the defeated who fall?​​
The choice is yours!​​

《Kings Call》Operations Team

Dear Players:

We will conduct a maintenance update [b]from 16:00 to 18:00 pm on August 12, 2025, Beijing time[/b]. The specific maintenance progress will be advanced or postponed depending on the maintenance progress. Thanks for your understanding. During this period, the game will be inaccessible and we are sorry for the inconvenience caused.

Say hello to Faerie, a brand-new mythic race born from the fusion of Elves and Angels. With unique racial traits and powerful battle potential, they’re ready to shake up your deck-building strategies. Dive in and discover their secrets!

Never reissued or replicated​
You are both the end and beginning of this legend.

notes.title: Kings Call Version Preview — Pet Island is Coming Soon!​
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

The brand-new [b][Pet Island][/b] will officially launched after the update on [b]August 5[/b]! This update combines resource gathering, strategic combat, and pet training for an immersive exploration experience.
 
Below are the detailed rules and features:

[b]Unlock Requirements[/b]

​Character Level: [b]≥40[/b]
​Prerequisite Quest:[b] Complete the "Pet System Unlock" tutorial[/b]
​Access Point: [b]“World” Teleportation Array in Main City → Click "Pet Island"[/b]

[b]Feature Highlights[/b]

[b]1. Solo PvE Exploration – No Competition, Full Freedom[/b]
Freely explore a shared map instance with other players. All resource nodes are calculated independently, ensuring a stress-free and fair gathering experience.

[b]2. Random Events – Strategy Meets Surprise[/b]
Each collection attempt may trigger one of two outcomes:
[b]Instant Reward: Receive resources immediately without combat
Combat Encounter: Defeating enemy increases the chance of receiving rare rewards[/b]

[b]3. Guaranteed Rewards – Three Core Resources[/b]

Every collection guarantees the following drops:
Silver: A core currency used for upgrading equipment and enhancing cards
Pet Food Fragments: Combine to craft pet-exclusive rations that unlock skills
Pet Essence: Exchange for valuable items in the Pet Island Shop to accelerate pet growth

[b]Attempts & Reset Rules​[/b]

​Daily Free Attempts: [b]5 (default)[/b]
​After attempts exhausted: [b]Wait for daily reset at 5:00 AM (Server Time)​​[/b]
Or expand attempts with Gold ( Gold-based attempt extension coming in future updates.)
​Status Indicators:
① Remaining attempts > 0: Nodes show cooldown timer
② Attempts depleted: Nodes locked (grayed out), auto-unlock next day

[b]​Future Plans​[/b]

The current release of Pet Island marks just the beginning of this exciting new feature. In future updates, the island will expand to include larger and more diverse regions, offering deeper exploration opportunities and richer strategic layers.

We also plan to introduce multiple tiers (or floors) of Pet Island. Each higher tier will bring greater challenges and significantly enhanced rewards, encouraging seasoned tamers to test their limits.
Additionally, multiplayer boss events are on the horizon—team up with other adventurers to take down powerful island bosses and earn exclusive loot!

Thank you for your continued support. We’ll see you on the island!

— Kings Call Operations Team

notes.title: Kings Call - Server Merge Adjustment Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

To enhance gaming experience, Kings Call will manage server merge adjustments during the maintenance period scheduled [b]for July 22, 2025, from 16:00 to 19:00 (UTC+8)[/b]. 

Please be aware of the maintenance time to avoid unnecessary losses. [u][b]The opening time of the unaffected servers will be advanced depending on progress.[/b][/u] We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Below are the details—please spread the word!

[b]① Server Merge Details[/b]
[b]NA6 will merge with NA5, with NA5 as the main server.[/b]
[u]Note: After the merge, all original login and character data will remain unaffected. Players can log in using their usual server selection.[/u]

[b]Merge Compensation: Festival Pack×5, Ticket Gift Pack×1, Fire Opal×1, Silver*200,000, Change Name Card x1
Compensation Eligibility: NA5~NA6[/b]

[b]② Cross-Server Adjustment[/b]
After the maintenance, [b]NA6 will be included in cross-server battles with NA1~5[/b]. Players on these servers can now team up, challenge dungeons, compete in the arena, and participate in cross-server rankings.
[b]Cross-Server Compensation: Mythos Pack ×2, Silver*100,000
Compensation Eligibility: NA5~NA6.[/b]

[b]➂ Important Reminders[/b]
[u]To avoid unnecessary losses, players on merged servers are advised to suspend all auction house transactions before maintenance. This includes listing items for sale, bidding, and ongoing transactions.[/u]

The final interpretation rights of this event belong to the official Kings Call team.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: King's Call Version Preview - Alchemy Synthesis System Coming Soon​
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

We are honored to announce a revolutionary strategic update coming to the game—the "[b]Alchemy Lab: Synthesis System[/b]" will be officially launched with the game update on [b]July 1, 2025[/b]! This system is designed to shatter the racial barriers of traditional creatures, allowing you to create unprecedented tactical combinations and battlefield dynamics. Below are the preview details for this new feature:

[b][u](Note: The following information is based on the test server preview. Final features are subject to the official live game version.)[/u][/b]

​Breakthrough Evolution: Consume redundant Cards to synthesize them and create powerful new Creatures.[b] Including eight new races such as the Holy warrior, Half-Elf, Aetherial, etc. Significantly expand your card library depth and battlefield formation strategies.[/b]

[u][b](Initial Release Race: Holy warrior. Subsequent Synthesis races will be released monthly.)[/b][/u]

[b]​Synthesis Mechanics:​​[/b]

[b]​Low Access Barrier: The Synthesis function becomes available once your Alchemy Lab building reaches Level 7.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/b3a69eb934865716b163892bdda56a508849ca1a.gif[/img]

[b]​Synthesis Resources:​​[/b]

[b]Synthesize Common, Good, Rare, Epic quality cards consumes:"Fusion Catalyst".
Synthesize Legendary, Godlike quality cards consumes: "Advanced Fusion Catalyst".[/b]
Fusion Catalyst can be obtained via the Tower Shop. Advanced Fusion Catalyst can be obtained through the Shop or limited-time events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/f9c75086b81dc3178df82d3e8c1fba46a501d6d0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/dd24d87f872a06affec06ce6c72e0bd8baae3ce7.png[/img]

[b]​User Guide:​​[/b]

[b]​1. Select Synthesis Materials​[/b]

Click on the Card Library on the right side of the interface to place first card. (Cards can be changed at any time by clicking).
Click the Race Resonance box below the selected card. The system will automatically filter the Card Library on the right to show eligible cards of the same quality that can be synthesized with the selected card based on its race.

[b]​2. Preview Synthesis Result​[/b]

Once both material cards are selected and placed, the "Preview" button will activate.
Click to preview all possible new Creature cards that can be created from this Synthesis pair, helping you adjust your combination strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/4764e6d4a60cca01b6453bedafca0655cc0891bb.png[/img]

[b]3. Execute Fusion​[/b]

The system automatically checks your inventory for the required Fusion Catalyst or Advanced Fusion Catalyst. If materials are sufficient: The "Synthesis" button will be highlighted. Confirm to complete the Synthesis and obtain your new Creature card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/77dff0684c3924137bcb47988a6384d740a0415c.png[/img]

[b]Notes​​[/b]

[u][b]New Synthesis creatures cannot be upgraded via Enhance methods. Strengthen them only in the Alchemy Lab’s [Combine] Interface using same-tier Synthesis cards.[/b][/u]

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to all adventurers for your enduring support and passion for Kings Call. The formidable power of the Alchemy Lab awaits—forge your unique legend! Please stay tuned for the official launch announcement.

Sincerely,
The Kings Call Operations Team

notes.title: 《King's Call》Version Preview - Pet Skill System Coming Soon
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The evolution of the pet system is about to enter a new chapter. Following the pet Reborn and Absorb features, we are delighted to announce that the ⭐[b]Pet Skill System[/b]⭐ will officially launch [b]on June 17, 2025, after the game update[/b]!

 This system aims to enhance pets' strategic value and combat effectiveness, providing you with more powerful and versatile companions for your adventures. Below are the key details of this new feature:
[u](Note: The following content is based on test server previews. Final features are subject to the live version.)[/u]

[u][b]​​I. Unlock Pet Skill​[/b][/u]

Pet skills are unique enhancements unlocked through leveling. Players can preview unlock conditions via [b][Pet] → [Feed] → [View Upgrade Bonus][/b]​​.
When a pet reaches Lv. 4, Lv. 6, and Lv. 8, it will unlock 1 additional skill each, for a maximum of 3 skills.
Skills must be activated through "Skill Comprehension".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/73a723333574d605f5b6575a41ac3af52c019991.png[/img]

[u][b]​​II. Skill Comprehension & Upgrade Rules​​[/b][/u]

[b]​​1. Prerequisite for Comprehension​​[/b]
Pets must unlock at least 1 Skill to use the "Skill Comprehension" function. Unavailable if no Skill slots are unlocked.

[b]​​2. Skill Capacity & Quality​​[/b]
Higher-quality pets can comprehend more skills and have a higher chance of obtaining rare skills:

[b]​​Common: Up to 4 skills​​
​​Good : Up to 9 skills​​
​​Rare: Up to 16 skills​​[/b]
[u](Epic+ pets will be supported in future updates.)[/u]

[b]​​3. Skill Pool & Randomization​​[/b]
All comprehensible skills are drawn from a quality-specific universal skill pool corresponding to each pet tier. Upon synthesis, the system randomly selects a unique set of comprehensible skills for each pet from the universal pool according to its quality tier. This means even pets with identical appearances may possess entirely different learnable skills...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/d359f2da576d34f15302286466e6e8bee9e88e1f.png[/img]

[b]​​4. Comprehension Operation​​[/b]

Select a target pet in the [Pet Skills] interface.
Click "Comprehend" to consume Gold, randomly drawing one skill from the pet’s skill pool.
The acquired skill fills an unlocked slot randomly. If the target slot is occupied, players can replace the existing skill.

[b]5.Daily Comprehension Attempt Limit:​​[/b]

To maintain game balance, a daily limit is placed on Skill Comprehension attempts per pet.
Each pet has a daily limit of 10 Skill Comprehension attempts. This limit is calculated individually per pet.​

[b]​​6. Skill Status Indicators​​[/b]

​​Highlighted icons: Skills already comprehended. Can be upgraded using corresponding ​​Skill Books.
​​Grayed-out icons: Skills in the pet’s pool but not yet comprehended. Cannot be upgraded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/85b3e1b37ce70f6d253603a53a0453b981d256df.png[/img]

[b]​​7. Skill Upgrades & Material Refunds​​[/b]
Comprehended skills start at Lv. 1. Use Skill Books to upgrade them to Lv. 3. Higher skill levels significantly boost effectiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/029aada2d66e36b1aa43b84f769b3d2cc5ed944e.png[/img]

[b]Material Refund:[/b]
When using a pet with Lv. 2+ skills as absorption material, reincarnation sacrifice, or reincarnation target (successful). The Skill Book used by the player to upgrade will be fully returned.

[u][b]​​III. Core Innovations​​[/b][/u]

[b]​​Deeper Progression Value:[/b]
Pet levels directly impact skill slot availability, adding strategic depth to long-term development.
[b]​​Unleashed Potential:[/b]
Randomized skill pools enable near-limitless customization, allowing players to train pets for specialized roles.
[b]​​Enhanced Combat Strategy:[/b]
Diverse new skills introduce tactical variety and elevate combat engagement.

The Pet Skill System marks a monumental leap in pet combat capabilities and opens new strategic dimensions for pet development. We believe this will revolutionize your journey through [i][b]King's Call[/b][/i].

Stay tuned to official channels for further details and release updates!​​
Thank you for your continued support.

​​  [i][b]King's Call [/b][/i]Operations Team​

notes.title: Ttrial dungeon - series is coming soon!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

A brand-new Trial Dungeon series – "Tome Hall" will officially arrive on [b]June 3[/b]! Get ready to challenge these dungeons and earn valuable rewards!

In the Tome Hall, you’ll face increasingly difficult trials and obtain rich rewards such as [b]Skill Tome Shard, Skill Tome, and Trial Shop Coins[/b]—all of which will help you greatly enhance your pets' combat skills in future updates!

[b]⭐New Dungeon Overview[/b]

Dungeon Name: [b]Tome Hall (Stages 1–5)[/b]
Dungeon Type: Trial
Unlock Levels: [b]Lv30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50 [/b]
Challenge Attempts: Can be increased by using Tome Hall Ticket or spending 300 Gold per attempt
Gameplay Mechanic: Flip cards for rewards upon successful completion

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/8261832ecbdd3cc80d95f557d6f326138c1dd82a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/186c9e35d61e138c13bc3698437ae80254d20d95.png[/img]

[b]⭐Key Rewards[/b]

Trial Shop Coins: [b]Rune Shard, Spirit Stone, Magic Sigil (usable in the upcoming Trial Shop)[/b]
Pet Skill Tome: [b]Random pet skill Tome Shard (Collect 10 Tome Shards to automatically craft a corresponding Pet Skill Tome, upgrading your pet's abilities in future pet skill system)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/66da07e4b4128b653f083397b7f107b95e3788a9.png[/img]

[b]⭐Additional Info[/b]

[b]Are Tickets Required? Yes (Available via in-game events or purchase)[/b]
The Trial Shop and Pet Skill System will be introduced in future versions—stay tuned to official announcements for updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/ef444bd519053dbdbfa0dc12e1f74d2584bec30d.png[/img]

That’s all for this preview of the June 3 update. The Tome Hall marks the beginning of a deeper Trial experience, and we’ll continue to bring even more challenge stages and shop content in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and passion for Kings Call. See you in the Trials!

notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that a brand new Children’s Day Event will go live[b] after the update on May 27, 2025[/b]!  
Servers: [b]NA1~6, EU1~6, AS1~3[/b]

[b]Event 1:[/b]
Children’s Day Dungeon: [b]Carnival[/b]
Additionally, there will be "Carnival" [b]first-clear rewards[/b] and [b]completion rewards[/b].
Level Requirements: Lv.30

Fashion of Children’s Day: [b]Fairy Dream[/b]
Validity: Permanent / Time-limited (7 days).

Mount of Children’s Day: [b]Rose Dolphin[/b]
Validity: Time-limited (7 days).

Pet of Children’s Day: [b]Panda Yoyo[/b]
Validity: Permanent

[b]Event 2:[/b]
[b]Children’s Day Quest[/b]: Children’s Day Quest, Claim Your Rewards!

[b]Event 3:[/b]
[b]Childlike Quests[/b]: Defeat specific monsters daily to earn rewards and items.

[b]Event 4:[/b]
[b]Childlike Exchange[/b]: Collect Specific Materials to Exchange for Rewards

[b]Event 5:[/b]
[b]Childlike Card Draw[/b]: Endless Surprises!

[b]Event 6:[/b]
[b]7-Day Login Rewards[/b]: Log in daily to receive a Children’s Day Exchange Material Box!

[b]Event 7:[/b]
Children’s Day Gift Code: [b]childrensday[/b]
Gift Code Contents:  
[u]- Children’s Day Gift Pack*1
- Children’s Day Material Box*1
- Cryptic Elf Pack III*5
- Opal Fragment*5  
- Ticket Gift Pack*1
- Silver*500,000  [/u]

Note: Each account can redeem once per server, including new servers.

[u][b]Event 1-7 Duration: May 27, 2025 (after game update) – June 3, 00:00 (UTC+8) [/b][/u]

[b]Event 8:[/b]
Dragon Boat Festival Gift Code: [b]DWKL[/b]
Gift Code Contents:
[u]- Grilled Lobster Fragment*30
- Tender Steak Fragment*20
- Bread Fragment*10
- Fire Opal*1
- Festival Pack*2
- Silver*200,000[/u]

Note: Each account can redeem once per server, including new servers.

[u][b]Event 8 Duration: May 31, 00:00 – June 3, 00:00 (UTC+8) [/b][/u]

notes.title: 《Kings Call》New Warehouse Feature Preview | Adventurer's Treasure Vault
notes.content:
​Dear Adventurers,​​

Kings Call is about to receive a massive upgrade! The highly anticipated[b]「Warehouse」[/b]feature will launch with [b]next week's update[/b], empowering you to bid farewell to overstuffed inventories and effortlessly manage your hoards of resources! 

[b]Unlock early version details below ↓[/b]

[u][b](The following content showcases test server development builds. Final features are subject to official server updates.)[/b][/u]

[b]Core Features​​[/b]

[b]Instant Access at Your Fingertips​​[/b]

A new Warehouse Manager [b][Lu Ban][/b] now appears in the world map! Interact to open the Warehouse Interface, where you can click the「Deposit」button to select items from your backpack for secure safekeeping of rare treasures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/927237911130131422be34ff7e3cb10e30f26436.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/65e932612cc1c17852f0f09ed5e8479986ee68f2.png[/img]

[b]Free Starter Vault for All​​[/b]

All players who reach[b] Level 20[/b] will unlock a [b]36-slot basic vault[/b]! No more agonizing over storing bulky crafting materials or excess quest items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/0e980a2462d28b5f92edad314a6c34a1b927a211.png[/img]

[b]Expand Your Horizons​​[/b]

Upgrade your vault capacity using in-game gold, expandable up to [b]180 slots[/b]—perfect for hoarders and collectors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/d224672c685ab88abb0cac439fc7351fd64c4ae0.png[/img]

​​Today's preview ends here. Thank you for your continued support and passion for Kings Call! We look forward to you discovering more thrilling content in the new update and enjoying an enhanced gaming experience.

​​—The Kings Call Team​

notes.title: Kings Call - Server Merge Adjustment Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

To enhance gaming experience, Kings Call will manage server merge adjustments during the maintenance period scheduled for [b]May 13, 2025, from 16:00 to 20:00 (UTC+8)[/b]. 

Please be aware of the maintenance time to avoid unnecessary losses. The opening time of the unaffectedl servers will be advanced depending on progress. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Below are the details—please spread the word!

[b]① Server Merge Details[/b]
[u][b]AS2, AS3 will merge with AS1, with AS1 as the main server.[/b][/u]
[u]Note: After the merge, all original login and character data will remain unaffected. Players can log in using their usual server selection.[/u]

Merge Compensation: [b]Festival Pack*5, Ticket Gift Pack*1, Fire Opal*1, Silver*200,000, Change Name Card *1[/b]
Compensation Eligibility: [b]AS1~AS3[/b]

[b]② Important Reminders[/b]
[u][b]To avoid unnecessary losses, players on merged servers are advised to suspend all auction house transactions before maintenance. This includes listing items for sale, bidding, and ongoing transactions.[/b][/u]

The final interpretation rights of this event belong to the official Kings Call team.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Special Offer Shop Now Open Once a Month: Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support and love for the game. In order to better balance the in-game economy and enhance the player experience, we have carefully considered and decided to adjust the opening frequency of the Special Offer Shop starting next month.

[b]The specific changes are as follows:
- Original plan: Open once a week
- Now adjusted to: Open once a month[/b]

We believe this adjustment will create a healthier in-game economic environment and give every player more time to plan their resources and game progress effectively.

The purpose of this change is to:
1. Provide more strategic thinking opportunities, making each opening of the Special Offer Shop a special event worth anticipating.
2. Better regulate in-game resources and spending, avoiding the imbalance caused by too frequent Special Offers.
3. Better cater to the needs of various players, especially those with limited resources and time.

[u][b]Additionally, please note that the Discount Shop on April 8th will be the last one for April![/b][/u]

We understand that this change may affect some players, but we believe it is an important step for the long-term development of the game. We will continue to monitor your feedback to ensure that each opening of the Special Offer Shop provides the best gaming experience.

Once again, thank you for your support and understanding! The final interpretation rights belong to the [i]Kings Call[/i] team!

notes.title: Kings Call - Server Merge & Cross-Server Adjustment Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

To enhance gaming experience, Kings Call will manage [b]server merge and cross-server adjustments[/b] during the maintenance period scheduled for [b]April 8, 2025, from 16:00 to 20:00 (UTC+8)[/b]. 
Please be aware of the maintenance time to avoid unnecessary losses. The actual server reopening time may be earlier or later than scheduled depending on progress. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Below are the details—please spread the word!

[b]① Server Merge Details[/b]

[b]EU4 will merge with EU3, with EU3 as the main server.
NA4 will merge with NA3, with NA3 as the main server.[/b]

[u]Note: After the merge, all original login and character data will remain unaffected. Players can log in using their usual server selection.[/u]

[b]Merge Compensation: Festival Pack*5, Ticket Gift Pack*1, Fire Opal*1, Silver*200,000, Change Name Card*1
Compensation Eligibility: NA3~NA4, EU3~EU4[/b]

[b]② Cross-Server Adjustment[/b]

[b]After the maintenance, NA5 will be included in cross-server battles with NA1~4, EU5 will be included in cross-server battles with EU1~4.Players on these servers can now team up, challenge dungeons, compete in the arena, and participate in cross-server rankings.[/b]

[b]Cross-Server Compensation: Mythos Pack*2, Silver*100,000
Compensation Eligibility: NA1~NA5, EU1~EU5[/b]

[b]③ Important Reminders[/b]

[u]To avoid unnecessary losses, players on merged servers are advised to suspend all auction house transactions before maintenance. This includes listing items for sale, bidding, and ongoing transactions.[/u]

The final interpretation rights of this event belong to the official Kings Call team.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: "Kings Call" Title System Preview
notes.content:
Dear Players:

Kings Call will be getting a new and exciting feature in the [b]next week's update[/b] -- [b]the Title System[/b]! We have been committed to bringing players more personalized choices. The addition of the Title System will provide every player with a new sense of achievement and identity symbol, helping you to show your glory in the arena!

[u][b](The following content is only for the test server, and the final version is subject to the official server update content.)[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/38c31bf7cc8adff08e065c2c38711492a70ed3d5.png[/img]
[b]Overview of the Title System[/b]

[b]The Title System allows players to earn unique titles based on their performance in the game, particularly in battles and events. Each title represents your strength and achievements and will bring additional rewards and a prestigious symbol of your status. (There are time-limited and permanent distinctions between different Titles.)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/83c352d3437837b6c5c2a2993b655f476e04c96e.gif[/img]

[b]Players can view/equip titles they have obtained in the Hero--Data interface. Other players can view titles equipped by players in the world, Character info and other interfaces.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/341617a85b5b9259faced7c11fb81d1dfbced769.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/b371c7346054fe88b1400cf8c27c1b18af428c85.png[/img]

In addition to basic titles, we plan to update advanced titles in future updates. These will be even more difficult to earn. This is the preview of the new version of the game today. We believe that these new features will bring you a richer gaming experience and fun. Please stay tuned for follow-up announcements on our official media for more update details and launch time.

Thank you for your continued support and love for "Kings Call"! We look forward to you discovering more exciting content in the new version and enjoying a brand new gaming experience.

notes.title: Announcement on the Modification and Compensation of Some Awakened Skills
notes.content:
Dear Players:

Hello everyone! In order to further optimize the game experience and improve the balance and fun of the game, we will adjust and modify some awakened skills in the update on [b]February 18, 2025[/b]. This change is mainly for some cards that have received more feedback from players. We found that the strength of some skills exceeded expectations after the launch of awakened skills, while some professions are still weak, which is not our original intention. In order to make all Classes in the game more competitive, we will weaken some cards and strengthen other cards.

Our long-term goal is to make the overall strength of each class in the game at a similar level. This adjustment may have a certain impact on the combat strategy and character development of some players. Therefore, we will explain the modifications in detail in the announcement and provide corresponding compensation measures for affected players. The following are the specific adjustments and compensation plans:

[b]I. Card Changes[/b]

The following cards are being adjusted to be weaker:

[b]Disturbance[/b]
[Before] This card has a 100% chance of returning to your hand after use.
[b][After] This card has a 56% chance of returning to your hand after use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/2621b392bd2a59798653a3b4494eb4031c18708a.png[/img]

[b]Swift Death[/b]
[Before] This card has a 56% chance of returning to your hand after use.
[b][After] This card has a 48% chance of returning to your hand after use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/6d08fd1b55c6f2fd456b8b896905d31397eb56c5.png[/img]

Development team notes: [Ranger's position in the game has always been a character who can launch a strong attack at any time and can cause interference to the opponent, so we gave the Ranger card a higher mastery rate. However, we have found that the strength of the Ranger's skills in a specific deck has exceeded expectations after the launch of the awakening skill. Therefore, we have reduced the mastery rate of these two cards, which can bring more room for other Classes.]

The following cards are being adjusted to be stronger:

[b]Command: Vigilance[/b]
[Before] This card has a 8% chance of returning to your hand after use.
[b][After] This card has a 16% chance of returning to your hand after use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/96dc692caa47c1d74e67e7032c752f0f82b9a0a0.png[/img]

[b]Resurrection[/b]
[Before] Countdown: 5
[b][After] Countdown: 3[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/412ecfb6b89493ee737e22ab0cf2e230c90f95d8.png[/img]

Development team notes: [These two cards have gained stronger effects after awakened, but they are not outstanding. We have implemented certain enhancements to them based on the opinions of players.]

[b]2. Compensation Plan[/b]

In order to thank players for their continued support and understanding of the game, for this modification of awakened skills, we will provide the following compensation to all affected players:
Each awakening quality "[b]Disturbance[/b]" & "[b]Swift Death[/b]"

[b]1. [Opal Fragments]: [50], this item can be used to [enlighten the card of Godlike quality] to help players better adapt to the game environment after the skill adjustment.[/b]

[b]2. [Silver]: [5,000,000], considering that some players upgraded their cards after the launch of the awakened skill, we have specially increased the silver compensation.[/b]

[u][b]The compensation list ends at server time [Beijing time February 17, 2025 16:30].
The compensation will be distributed to the player's account through in-game email after the next maintenance. Please check it.[/b][/u]

[b]3. Subsequent Optimization Plan[/b]

We are always committed to creating a fairer and more interesting game world for players. After this awakening skill modification, we will pay close attention to the operation of the game and the feedback of players. If you find other areas that need to be adjusted, please provide your opinions. At the same time, we will also regularly launch new game content and activities to enrich the player's gaming experience.

We are well aware that every adjustment may cause inconvenience to players, but please believe that our goal is always to make the game better. Thank you for your understanding and support, let us look forward to a more exciting game world together!

Kings Call Operation Team
February 17, 2025

notes.title: Kings Call:  Preview of Adjustments to Some Skill Cards
notes.content:
Dear Players,

In order to continuously optimize the game experience and maintain the balance and fun of the game, we plan to adjust the effects of some Awakened skill cards. After in-depth testing and summarizing player feedback, we have formulated the following card adjustment plan.

[b]Adjustment Preview[/b]

[b][Command: Vigilance]:[/b]
[Before] This card has a 8% chance of returning to your hand after use.
[After] [b]This card has a 16% chance of returning to your hand after use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/96dc692caa47c1d74e67e7032c752f0f82b9a0a0.png[/img]

[b][Disturbance]:[/b]
[Before] This card has a 100% chance of returning to your hand after use.
[After] [b]This card has a 56% chance of returning to your hand after use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/2621b392bd2a59798653a3b4494eb4031c18708a.png[/img]

[b][Swift Death]:[/b]
[Before] This card has a 56% chance of returning to your hand after use.
[After] [b]This card has a 48% chance of returning to your hand after use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/6d08fd1b55c6f2fd456b8b896905d31397eb56c5.png[/img]

[b][Resurrection]:[/b]
[Before] Countdown: 5
[After] [b]Countdown: 3[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/412ecfb6b89493ee737e22ab0cf2e230c90f95d8.png[/img]

Your voice

We always regard the opinions of players as valuable assets. If you have any questions, suggestions or ideas about this adjustment, please feel free to contact us.

Special note

[u][b]The skill adjustment preview released this time is not the final version. In the subsequent testing and evaluation process, we will flexibly adjust the skills based on your feedback and the actual operation of the game.[/b][/u]Thank you for your understanding and support. Thank you for being a part of our game community.

notes.title: Valentine's Day Themed Fashion Preview Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

Valentine's Day is approaching, and we’ve prepared special [b]Valentine’s Day-themed fashion and mount[/b] to bring you a double dose of sweetness and magic!

Fashion: [b]Beloved Sweetheart[/b]
With its sweet pink tones and romantic design, this fashion set will make you the bright star this Valentine’s Day!

Mount: [b]Magical Spirit Cat[/b]
This mount is full of fantasy and magic, galloping alongside you in battle and adding a touch of wonder to your adventures!

Preview Note:  
[b][u]We’ve provided reference images for the fashion and mount, but please note that the actual in-game appearance may differ slightly. Stay tuned for the final version once it goes live![/u][/b]

Release Time:  
[b]After the February 11th update, the fashion and mount will be available through limited-time events.  [/b]
Stay tuned for more details in future announcements!

notes.title: New Year Event is Coming
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re excited to announce the launch of our special New Year event, starting on [b]January 21, 2025[/b]!
Server: [b]NA1-5, EU1-5, AS1-3[/b]

[b]Event 1:[/b]

[b]Spring Serpent・Nadja the Viper Awakening[/b]
Event Goal: Players need to collect cards of different rarities (Epic, Legendary, Godlike, Awakened). Rewards will be given at each stage. Collect all the variants of Nadja the Viper  to unlock amazing grand prizes!
Card Rarity and How to Obtain:
Epic Cards: Can be obtained through card draws and dungeon challenges.
Legendary Cards: Can be obtained through card draws, dungeon challenges, and card enhancement.
Godlike Cards: Can be obtained through card enhancement.
Awakened Cards: Can be obtained through card enhancement.
[b]Event time: After the update on January 21, 2025 ~ 0:00 on January 28 (Beijing time)[/b]

[b]Event 2:

Spring Benefit: Defeat designated monsters each day to earn event points.
Event time: After the update on January 21, 2025 ~ 0:00 on February 4 (Beijing time)

Event 3:

Nadja Awakened Celebration: Card drawings with points
Event time: After the update on January 21, 2025 ~ 0:00 on February 4 (Beijing time)

Event 4:

Double Experience/Silver
Event time: After the update on January 21, 2025 ~ 0:00 on February 4 (Beijing time)

Event 5:

Spring Benefit: With Gratitude, Special Offer, Enjoy the Feast!
Event time: 0:00 on February 4, 2025 ~ 0:00 on February 11 (Beijing time)[/b]

[b]Event 6:

Serpent Blessings: Auspicious Serpent, Big Rewards Await!
Event time: 0:00 on January 28, 2025 ~ 0:00 on February 4 (Beijing time)[/b]

[b]Event 7:

Sign-in rewards:[/b]
[u]Day 1: Silver*800,000
Day 2: Goddess of Serpent Edjo (Godlike)*1
Day 3: Unicorn Tempest*1
Day 4: Ticket Gift Pack*5
Day 5: Lunar Chest (Legendary)*1
Day 6: Master's Skill Pack IV*5
Day 7: Black Opal Fragment*6[/u]
[b]Event time: 0:00 on January 28, 2025 ~ 0:00 on February 6 (Beijing time)[/b]

Event 8:

New Year Login Rewards:

[b]Level Rewards:[/b]

Players who have logged in since January 14th and have a character level of 15 or higher will receive: [u]Fire Opal*1 / Elixir of Energy (10 Energy)*5 / Silver*660,000[/u].
Players who have logged in since January 14th and have a character level of 30 or higher will receive: [u]Legendary Box*1 / Ticket Box*2 / Silver*880,000[/u].
Players who have logged in since January 14th and have a character level of 45 or higher will receive: [u]Legendary Box*2 / Ticket Box*5 / Wish Coins*6 / Silver*1,880,000 / Tempest Pack*1[/u].
[b]Reward Distribution Time: January 23
Reward Rules: Players who reach the specified level and have logged into the game since January 14th will be eligible to claim the reward package by 11:59 PM on January 22, 2025.[/b]

[b]VIP Rewards:

Reward Distribution Time: January 23
Reward Rules: Players who reach the specified VIP level by 11:59 PM on January 22, 2025, will be eligible to claim the reward package.[/b]

[b]Note: The above level & VIP rewards can only be claimed once per account, per server, including new servers.[/b]

[b]Event 9:[/b]

Gift Code: [b]newyear[/b]
Contents of gift code:
[u]Spring Festival Treasure*1
Royal Pack*5
Fire Opal*2
Black Opal Fragment*5
Ticket Gift Pack*2
Silver*880,000[/u]

Note: Each account can only claim it once on each server, including new servers.
Validity Period of Gift Code: [b]After the game update on January 21st - 00:00 on January 28th (Beijing time)[/b]

[u][b]Announcement Notice: Each event has a designated time frame. To ensure you secure all available rewards, please plan your time effectively, complete the event tasks promptly, and redeem your rewards without delay.[/b][/u]

Recently, we have received reports about Boosting of some players, which has had a negative impact on the game and players. After discussion, we decided to take a series of corresponding measures based on the severity of the boosting behavior.

Specific Clearing List:

[b]1.Clear certain points:[/b]
[i]SwiftRaid
LeviAckermann
Maroxin
Imperador[/i]

[b]2.Clear all points:[/b]
[i]Vhitana
Faeel
20matar
Kiperblady
Knighting
Imhotep
Chefa
LordSamael[/i]

notes.title: Announcement of New Server Opening (EU5) 20250108
notes.content:
Dear players:

We are pleased to announce that Kings Call will soon open a new server. The specific opening time is as follows:
Server Name: [b]EU5[/b]
Opening Time: [b]9:00 am on January 8, 2025 (UTC)[/b]

In addition, we have specially prepared a variety of opening events and gift codes. Welcome to set sail with us and start a new journey.

Gift Code of Server EU5: [b]KCEU5[/b]

Contains:
[b]Epic Gem*10
Silver*10,000
Festival Pack*2
Tower Ticket*5
Fire Opal*1[/b]

Please note:
1. [b]Each account can only receive it once[/b]
2. Valid Collection Period: [b]Updated on January 8, 2025 ~ January 14, 2025 0:00[/b]

The following are the main contents of this maintenance:

[b][Event][/b]

[b]1.Supremacy: Tarsis
2.Buy Points, Get Rewards: 8000 - Enchantress Evelyn (Legendary) / 30000 - Enchantress Evelyn (Godlike)
3.Event of Horsehair
4.Value Rebates
5.Secrets of the Tarot (The Mimic)
6.20-day Fund
7.Gold Rush (Weekly Event)[/b]
[u]Consume 100 gold coins: Tower Ticket*3, Silver*10,000, Bread Fragment*10
Consume 500 gold coins: Starlight Chest (Epic)*1, Crystal Gift Pack*2, Bread Fragment*10
Consume 1,000 gold coins: Snow Raccoon (Epic)*1, Crystal Gift Pack*3, Tender Steak Fragment*20

Consume 30,000 gold coins: Fire Ruby*2, Solar Chest (Legendary)*2, Silver*3,000,000
Consume 50,000 gold coins: Black Opal*1, Solar Chest (Legendary)*2, Silver*4,000,000[/u]
[b]8.Pack (Limited Time Event) - Booster Bonanza[/b]
[u]20 packs of Victory Pack - Black Opal*1 / Silver*3,000,000
20 packs of Angel-Demon Pack - Goblin War Turtle (Legendary)*1/ Starlight Chest (Epic)*1

notes.title: Kings Call: Announcement on Punishments for Exploiting Item Duplication Bug
notes.content:
Dear Players,

To maintain a fair and just gaming environment, we are committed to providing an enjoyable experience for all. Recently, we discovered that some players maliciously exploited a game bug to duplicate items, severely disrupting the balance of the game and the experience of other players. We take this matter very seriously and have implemented the following measures:

[b]1. Bug Fix[/b]
The bug has now been fully resolved, and the issue will not recur. We appreciate the community's attention and support for fair gameplay.

[b]2. Punishments for Involved Players[/b]
According to the relevant content in Chapter 4 of the STEAM® SUBSCRIBER AGREEMENT, "[b]ONLINE CONDUCT, CHEATING AND PROCESS TAMPERING[/b]", After a detailed data check, we have the right and decide to take the following actions against all players who exploit loopholes to obtain items:
2 players who used bugs to obtain items and the circumstances were serious will be banned for 2 months

If you have any questions about the above content, you can contact us through the official email: [b]huoyanzhengcheng@gmail.com[/b]

Please note: The above punishments have been enforced as of the publication of this announcement, and the accounts of the listed players have already been dealt with.

[b]STEAM® SUBSCRIBER AGREEMENT:
https://store.steampowered.com/subscriber_agreement/[/b]

[b]3. Commitment to Fair Play[/b]
We are committed to upholding a fair gaming environment and will not tolerate any behavior that disrupts game balance. Moving forward, we will continue to enhance bug detection and prevention to ensure the healthy development of the game.

[b]4. Encouraging Player Reports[/b]
We encourage all players to actively report any violations within the game. Successful reports will be rewarded, with specific reward details to be announced in future communications.

Thank you for your understanding and support!
We hope all players will cherish the gaming environment and enjoy a fair and fun experience. If you have any questions about this announcement, please contact us through our official customer service channels.

Best regards,
[i]Kings Call [/i]Operations Team

notes.title: Kings Call Weapon Special Effects Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear Players,

In order to enhance the gameplay experience and visual effects, we will be conducting a comprehensive update of the weapon special effects in the near future. This update will add more dazzling and expressive special effects to various weapons, not only enhancing the visual impact of combat but also providing players with a more immersive and diverse sense of hitting power.

Update Details:

[b]1.Weapon Attack Special Effects Overhaul[/b]
We have reworked the attack special effects for several weapons. The new effects are more refined, delivering a stronger visual impact. Every strike has been carefully crafted, allowing players to feel the power and strength of their weapons more clearly in battle.

notes.title: Pet System 2.0 Preview
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are pleased to announce that [i][b]Kings Call[/b][/i] is about to enter a new chapter - "[b]Pet System 2.0[/b]" is about to debut! In this update, we have brought two revolutionary new gameplays: [b]Pet Absorb and Pet Reborn[/b]. Aims to enhance your pet training experience and make your pet a more effective partner on your adventure.

⭐ [b]Pet Absorb: More Efficient Resource Utilization[/b]⭐

[b]Experience Transfer: Players can transfer the experience of other pets in your team to the target pet. This innovative feature will help you use resources more effectively, avoid duplication of work when training low-level pets, and greatly improve the efficiency of pet training.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/4cd05c9088870ba746a34fd242c8a02808984cf0.png[/img]

[b]The upgrade progress of the sacrificed pet will also be absorbed, and will disappear after absorption. Different quality pets contribute different experience to the target pet when they are selected for absorption. The higher the quality, the more experience they contribute.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/875fb0fb68c09d85d728dd66c778106472e11279.png[/img]

[b]The target pet's information will also show the growth value, level, and status changes after absorbing the pet, which can help players quickly understand the pet's improvement.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/9d648fde26f0019207819b9e6ceaf52e926f9e21.png[/img]

⭐[b]Pet Reborn: A Leap in Quality and Ability[/b]⭐

[b]Pet Reborn: Use your extra pets as sacrifices and offer them to a pet to give it a chance to transform. The target pet will transform into a new pet of higher quality, with more powerful status and new pet skills, making your battle strategy more diverse.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/bd658ed9fd4326a88098339a4b83b718db2d68aa.png[/img]

[b]The quality of the sacrifice pet will affect the success rate of reborn. The higher the quality of the sacrifice pet, the greater the contribution to the success rate. At the same time, the quality of the sacrifice pet can only be equal to or lower than the target pet by 1 quality. Players can choose multiple sacrifice pets to offer success rate of reincarnation.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/af7a5891cdfbb8b7fb27f59987e46c455861b9ea.png[/img]

[b]The reincarnated pet will become a new pet of higher quality, with more powerful talents and new pet skills, but will not inherit the pet skill level of the original pet. There is a certain chance of failure in reborn, and the sacrifice pet will be consumed when it fails, but at the same time it will permanently increase the success rate of the next reborn.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/14e1808bc9337153585c998cdc49882c5d12a5b4.png[/img]

⭐ [b]Changes brought by Pet System 2.0[/b] ⭐

[b]Improved training efficiency[/b]: With the pet absorb function, you can train powerful pets faster without repeatedly investing time and energy.
[b]Pet quality upgrade[/b]: The pet reborn function gives your pet the opportunity to obtain higher quality and become an indispensable force in your adventure.
[b]New skill experience[/b]: The reincarnated pet will bring new skills to add more possibilities to your battle.

We know that every adventurer hopes that their pet can be a strong backing on the journey. The launch of Pet System 2.0 is to respond to this expectation and make your pet training journey more exciting.

Please stay tuned, more details about Pet System 2.0 and the launch date will be revealed one after another. We look forward to welcoming this exciting new journey with you!

The screenshots and content above are from the test server version. The final version will be based on the official release. All rights of interpretation are reserved by the [i][b]Kings Call[/b][/i] team.

notes.title: Kings Call New Version Preview
notes.content:
Dear Players:

We are very happy to announce that [b][i]Kings Call[/i][/b] will bring you a sincere update-----[b]Fashion System[/b]!

[b]The fashion system is designed to provide players with a rich and diverse selection of character appearance customization. Fashion can make your character have a super cool and unique style, festivals, technology, fantasy, and all kinds of theme fashions are available![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/0b63ee76428d6d14123dc494b56424ae6121db42.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/ab1fb718d728f4abce333ef10e569ba31739fefb.gif[/img]
(The actual performance is subject to the final online version in the game)

[b]After obtaining the fashion, you can equip it in the backpack of the "Character" interface. According to different qualities, the fashion will be divided into 5 levels: good, rare, epic, legendary, and godlike. The higher the level of the fashion, the richer the special effects. The fashion can also be linked with the horse you equip to add features to your beloved mount.[/b]

[b]The fashion in the game is divided into time-limited and permanent. Players can obtain fashions of various quality levels through different channels.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/5a44683bcd618e73382b8c6447512d3b644e1161.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/f55949952fb434e28e8797b9fc330a086383477d.gif[/img]
(The actual performance is subject to the final online version in the game)

[b]What's more surprising is that the fashion also comes with extra bonuses, such as life, blocking, and hero crits are comprehensively improved to help you gallop on the battlefield. Come and experience a different fighting style![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757982/c4ac17dbac2c265acd1dfb68a4e93c4255a1f2d7.png[/img]

This is the preview of the new version of the game today. We believe that these new features will bring you a richer gaming experience and fun. Please stay tuned for follow-up announcements on our official media for more update details and launch time.

Thank you for your continued support and love for [b][i]Kings Call[/i][/b]! We look forward to you discovering more exciting content in the new version and enjoying a brand new gaming experience.

notes.title: Kings Call: Skill Adjustments and Compensation Details
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We hope this message brings you good news. In light of recent developments and the valuable feedback we've received, we have decided to make some adjustments to our previously announced skill adjustment plans.

[b]***"Mirrorcraft" Skill Adjustment***[/b]

Based on actual testing and feedback, we have decided to prioritize the adjustment of the mage skill "Mirrorcraft." The original adjustment plan remains unchanged, and the "Mirrorcraft" skill will be updated according to the previously announced adjustment plan as scheduled.

[b]【Mirrorcraft】:[/b]
[Before]: Single-target skill: Summon a copy of a target creature
[After]: [b]Single-target skill: Summon a copy of a target creature. Has no effect on elites.[/b]

[b][Before][/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/9976665473c0d87951b2fc05dbbc52ab70fc12c6.png[/img]
[b][After][/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/57f86e901f156f9d0cd441013f5931982f7468c5.png[/img]

[b]***Compensation Standards and List for "Mirrorcraft" Modification***[/b]

The compensation standards and list for the "Mirrorcraft" adjustment will be executed according to the original rules. We appreciate everyone's understanding and patience as we work to ensure that these changes and compensations are properly implemented.
The final confirmation time for the compensation list is server time[[b]October 30, 2024, 12:00 Beijing time[/b]].

[b]Compensation Standard:[/b]

[b][For each “Godlike” quality card]: [u]Master’s Skill Pack IV *5 + silver *2,000,000 + Medal of honor *200 + Lunar Chest (Legendary) *2[/u]
[For each “Legendary” quality card]: [u]Master’s Skill Pack IV *2 + silver *500,000 + Medal of honor *100 + Starlight Chest (Epic) *1[/u]
[For each “Epic” quality card]: [u]Master’s Skill Pack IV *1 + silver *100,000 + Medal of honor *60[/u][/b]

[b]***Temporary Suspension of Other Skill adjustments***[/b]

   The adjustments to other skills mentioned in the previous announcement ([b]Blood Exchange, Impartial Decree, Death's Door[/b]) will be temporarily suspended. We believe this decision will allow us to focus more on refining other skill changes to better meet everyone's expectations and enhance the gaming experience.

[b]***Adaptability of Other Planned Skill Changes***[/b]

 We would like to further clarify that the originally planned adjustments for other skills may be adapted based on the actual situation in the game, which means that the final implemented skill changes may differ from the initially announced version. These adjustments are based on several key factors, including player feedback, game balance, and data monitoring and analysis. Therefore, although we initially had a clear plan for skill changes, we will adjust flexibly based on the above factors to ensure that the final skill changes bring the best gaming experience to all players.

We value everyone's support and understanding, and we will make these changes with your assistance. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us. We are here to listen and improve the game.

Thank you for being a part of our gaming community.

Development Team

notes.title: Kings Call: Announcement of Card Adjustments and Compensation
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We aim to ensure that your gaming experience is always the best, and we are continuously working to improve and adjust game content. To maintain game balance and enjoyment, we plan to adjust the effects of certain skill cards. Below are the details of the updates and corresponding compensation plans.

[b]# Skill Adjustment Schedule #[/b]

We expect to conduct maintenance updates on [b]November 5, 2024, Beijing time, Server time[/b]. During this update, we will adjust the cards: “[b]Mirrorcraft[/b],” “[b]Blood Exchange[/b],” “[b]Impartial Decree[/b],” and “[b]Death's Door[/b].” Please keep an eye on in-game notifications.

[b]# Skill Adjustment Effects #[/b]

After careful consideration and player feedback, we have made the following adjustments to the four cards:

[b]【Mirrorcraft】:[/b]

[Before]: Single-target skill: Summon a copy of a target creature
[After]: [b]Single-target skill: Summon a copy of a target creature. Has no effect on elites[/b]

[b][Before][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/9976665473c0d87951b2fc05dbbc52ab70fc12c6.png[/img]
[b][After][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/57f86e901f156f9d0cd441013f5931982f7468c5.png[/img]

[b]【Blood Exchange】:[/b]

[Before]: Blood Exchange: Single-target skill: Kill a target enemy creature at the cost of a random friendly creature
[After]: [b]Single-target skill: Kill a target friendly creature at the cost of a random enemy creature[/b]

[b][Before][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/262e3d483be22389e6eaad9346e5f57983f4bb19.png[/img]
[b][After][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/175d60b2f39143b03b11c79712b9d095d06005e4.png[/img]

[b]【Impartial Decree】:[/b]

[Before]: Single-target skill: Reduce target enemy creature's attack to 1
[After Modification]: [b]Single-target skill: Reduce target enemy creature's attack to 1 for 2 turn[/b]

[b][Before][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/cd781da9c89c15f836136797d78f1636fcdc3c44.jpg[/img]
[b][After][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/dc5e77c077699229bd1f10263febafe4a76bbb67.png[/img]

[b]【Death's Door】:[/b]

[Before]: Single-target skill: Reduce target enemy creature's life to 1
[After]: [b]Single-target skill: Single-target skill: Stun a target enemy creature for 2 turn[/b]

[b][Before][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/c0aaa3cde3ca9d8ec40031ad1800bec3e70040de.png[/img]
[b][After][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/560441b275d31062e32b83aca9b91383bd7a5a0d.png[/img]

We believe these adjustments will make the game more balanced and provide you with a better gaming experience.

[b]# Skill Adjustment Compensation #[/b]

To thank you for your support and understanding, we will provide compensation to all players who own the modified cards, based on the card quality ([u][b]compensation is stackable[/b][/u]).

[[b]For each “Godlike” quality card[/b]]: [u][b]Master’s Skill Pack IV *5 + silver *2,000,000 + Medal of honor *200 + Lunar Chest (Legendary) *2[/b][/u]
[[b]For each “Legendary” quality card[/b]]: [u][b]Master’s Skill Pack IV *2 + silver *500,000 + Medal of honor *100 + Starlight Chest (Epic) *1[/b][/u]
[[b]For each “Epic” quality card[/b]]: [u][b]Master’s Skill Pack IV *1 + silver *100,000 + Medal of honor *60[/b][/u]

The final confirmation time for the compensation list is server time[[b]October 30, 2024, 12:00 Beijing time[/b]].

Please note:

[b]1.After this time, any changes in the number of your relevant cards will no longer affect the issuance of compensation.
2.Only the number of cards in your deck affects the calculation of compensation; cards in the auction house do not count.[/b]

To ensure that compensation reaches your account smoothly, the above compensation may be issued in batches. Please keep an eye on your in-game mailbox and collect your compensation in a time.

After the skill adjustment, we will make adaptive adjustments to the intensity of game content, including dungeons, based on actual conditions. We understand that any changes may affect your gaming experience, and we promise to continue monitoring the effects of these adjustments. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Kings Call Version Preview
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The World Scene, which was mentioned in the August version revelation of [i][b]Kings Call[/b][/i], will be available to all players [u][b]on October 22, 2024 after the update[/b][/u]! As a brand new game scene, the main purpose of [b][World Scene][/b] is to strengthen the communication between players and show their style, and we are going to learn more about the details and the update plan from Q4 2024 to Q4 2025.

Warm tips: The following are all test servers or art effect displays. The final effect is subject to the official online version. The [i][b]Kings Call[/b][/i] team has the final right of interpretation.

[b]1. Update of [World Scene][/b]

[b]Players can enter or leave the world scene by clicking the [World][Inner City] button in the main city scene of the game.[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/cb2dac874b9a77ca9bc3aa449a9a72932a4f58da.gif[/img]

[b]In addition, players who enter the scene can walk around freely. If the player is carrying a pet, the pet will also follow.[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/9006908562014c74fd1d16c29a09398f96d8537a.gif[/img]

[b]In the world scene, players' chat messages will not only be displayed in the chat box, but also on the avatars of the characters in the scene with the effect of chat message bubbles.[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/b54fb0ad258ac1a993c725a729e3d6a90b806eb7.gif[/img]

As the first version of the world scene, the design and development team will try to improve the players' experience as much as possible under the premise of ensuring stability. We will also gradually enrich the supporting functions of the world scene in the subsequent version updates to further enhance the player experience.

[b]2.More Updates Preview[/b]

We expect to launch more updates and optimizations aimed at improving the fun and experience of the game from the end of 2024 to 2025. The following is the planning of some content.

[b][Q4, 2024]
①**Pet System**[/b]
Open pet reborn & new skill talents. The opening of new functions is to make pets more growth-oriented and avoid the waste of training resources. At the same time, new skills will also make your favorite pets more powerful.
[b]②**World Scene Honor Display**[/b]
Players with special honors will get a special display position in the world scene to show their status.

[b][Q1-Q2, 2025]
①**Mount System**[/b]
The new mount system will not only be limited to battles, but will also show other players your cool mounts in more scenes including the world.
[b]②**Title System**[/b]
Players can obtain titles and show their unique charm in different scene.
[b]③**Fashion System**[/b]
Different fashion combinations will be reflected in the game, especially in the world scene, it will no longer be a stereotyped "professional outfit".

[b][Q3-Q4, 2025]
①**Pet Island**
②**Resource Battle**[/b]

[b][Ongoing]
**Art quality iteration**[/b]
In addition, we will continue to iterate and optimize the art quality. Whether it's the game scenes or the character models of the cards, we will continue to optimize this aspect.

We have not done it perfectly along the way, but we will always keep a player-first heart and continue to enrich and optimize the game content. We also welcome players to give feedback and communicate on our plans. Thank you for your support along the way.

notes.title: National Day-themed Event is Coming
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that on [b]October 1, 2024, Server Time[/b], a brand new National Day special dungeon and events will be updated in the game!

[b]Covered Servers: NA1-4, EU1-4, AS1-3[/b]

[b]Event1:[/b]

[b]National Day Dungeon: [i]Lucky Journey[/i][/b]
[b]Dungeon Features: [/b]In this dungeon, players will embark on a journey to sunny beaches. Waves crash on the shore, and mysterious treasures are hidden in the sand. Players must avoid sudden attacks from seagulls, defeat monsters disguised in sandcastles, and explore the mysterious ruins at the end of the coast to earn precious rewards and unique items.
There are first-pass rewards and clearance rewards for the "[b][i]Fastest Challenge of National Day.[/i][/b]"
[b]Unlock Conditions: [i]Level 30[/i][/b]
[b]Opening Time: 0:00 on October 1, 2024 - 0:00 on October 8, 2024 (Server Time)[/b]

[b]Event2:[/b]

[b]National Day Legend Return Store[/b]
To celebrate the National Day, the game will launch the [b]Legend Returns Store & Legend Exchange Event[/b] for a limited time [b]from 0:00 on October 1st to 0:00 on October 8th, 2024, Server Time[/b]! The Legend Return Store will launch [b]Legend Master Packs I~VI[/b], and different activity points can be obtained by purchasing different card packs. Activity points can be used to exchange cards, props and other items in Legend Exchange.

Note:
[b]1. [Legend Returns] store card packs have a purchase limit, and the purchase limit is reset at 24:00 every day on the server time;
2. [Legend Exchange] items have a redemption limit during the event period, and the redemption limit will not be reset, and the redemption will end when all are redeemed;
3. The points will be cleared at the end of the redemption event, please redeem and use them in time;
4. The final right of interpretation of this event belongs to the operation team.[/b]

notes.title: Announcement on the launch of the pet system and new novice function
notes.content:
Dear players:

We are pleased to announce that the new pet system and new novice features of Kings call will be officially launched on September 10, 2024!

[b]New novice functions:[/b]

The optimized novice guidance system will help new players get started with the game more quickly and fully understand the game mechanics and gameplay.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/782970f2b28bf2d750489af5afb1699cbe894575.png[/img]

[b]New pet system:[/b]

[b]· Open level:[/b] The pet system is opened when the hero level reaches level 20.
[b]· Exclusive entrance: [/b]Players can enter the pet system through the "Pet" entrance in the main city interface.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/067a03808c22717c46e6c69a7814827c6c614966.png[/img]

[b]· Basic functions[/b]
Synthesis: Synthesize pets by using a specified number of pet fragments.
Feeding: Feed pets with food items to increase their levels. Higher levels can increase the pet's basic attack power, talent level, and unlock skills.
Talents: Different talents will bring different combat bonuses.
Skills: Pets have their own exclusive skills to play a role in battle. (Open later)

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/16f94f28f17fa6b749a1fd58f1d466fff8418e1c.png[/img]

The following is the display effect of some pets and talent skills in the test server. The final content is subject to the online version. All rights of interpretation belong to the Kings call Team.

Pet name: Sea Lizard
Skill and Talent: Beast Roar

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/66bc86031b94adebdb52ec5e4f2ae7138d064e15.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/a0a0589e9d8c22df8f80653da0796897abe7efb5.png[/img]

Pet name: Hairy Pig
Skill and Talent: Feral

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/226325100e35a8aec143f8ebce24dea055936f1c.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/32b9c5baafa01858cd408eacfc71e11ed24b527b.png[/img]

Pet name: Black Wind Wolf
Skill and Talent: Rampage 1

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/4023dea8a3fa9356b02b84ae2e6a210893f8c2a6.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/193b6138ccb64cbab4206e7ce564587d18ce9895.png[/img]

[b]· Collaborative battle: [/b]Pets will participate in the battle, providing additional support and skill effects for your battle, making you more handy in the challenge.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/37cb261bd5993a1d1583e20cd27293d99ca589a4.png[/img]

[b]· Other functions: [/b]Pet fragments and food fragments obtained from dungeons or activities are transferred from the original personal backpack to the pet's exclusive backpack, freeing up space in the personal backpack so that players can better manage other items.

Thank you for your continued support and love for Kings call. In the future, Pet Reborn, Pet Skills and other functions will be opened one after another. We look forward to exploring new content with you and meeting more challenges!

notes.title: kings call version update revelation
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are very happy to announce that kings call will bring you a series of exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. The following are the main contents of the new features:

1. [b]New version of novice guide[/b]

[b]Monologue Episode[/b] A new monologue will be added to the new guide, centered around the protagonist investigating the mysterious disappearance of an explorer during his quest. This episode will reveal more of the backstory and mission objectives, making the start of your game even more intriguing.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/c0ad909bad4be7dd416e567d814a433d2caa1b36.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/11f44da9d3ac1e29f62ab22761ee0c9545fed0e3.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/fa4202fe425aac80f97adafe6e71a78718344fdb.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/a51daa50bcdd2ba42e0b23016cd967ce5712cb01.jpg[/img]

[b]Icon guidance and character movement function[/b] In order to help players better explore the game world, we have introduced icon guidance and character movement functions to make the game scenes more vivid and real. With the movement of the game characters, you can not only see the dynamic movement of the characters in various scenes, but this function will also provide players with clear navigation guidance, so that you can find mission objectives and important scenes more easily.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/a69de3e9589c175356aab1fdd27d846f46275cbd.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/d4f1337a2d69293d8f83633d172fcb3b195166f1.jpg[/img]

2. [b]New “World” entrance in the main city interface[/b]

[b]World function display[/b] The newly added "World" entrance will become an important window for you to understand the game world. "World" not only includes the original character movement function in the novice tutorial, but also allows you to see the explorers' waiting screen in the main city and the display scene of the top three explorers' glory moments.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/fcf74ab01155ba2e18d6a527c69e028264b95cd0.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/e0af8aa78977691d717a7d64510e685e75328c8d.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/34f1095dd8a2080e16e6d51c53d8959065264162.jpg[/img]

3. [b]Open pet system[/b]

[b]Pets fight side by side with players[/b] We have opened a new pet system. Each pet has unique skills and talents, which can provide players with additional attribute bonuses, such as attack, block, life, etc. In battle, pets will assist players in attacking enemies, reduce the pressure of your battle, and become a powerful partner on your adventure.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/d2cb5cd1646a2d13f638daa71345410fffc97208.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44757982/143f48bbab2831d79669d53677495c14e5ce3ffa.jpg[/img]

We believe that these new features will bring you a richer gaming experience and fun. Stay tuned to our official platform for more details on the update and when it will be available.

Thank you for your continuous support and love for kings call! We look forward to seeing you in the new version to discover more exciting content and enjoy a brand new gaming experience.

notes.title: Announcement of Game Special Card Customization on Kings Call
notes.content:
Dear Kings Call Game Players,

Thanks for your support and love for our game! To reciprocate the kindness of our players and provide a unique gaming experience for our esteemed [b]VIP12 players[/b], we have specially launched a [b]VIP12 Special Card Customization Service[/b]!

[b][Customization Content][/b]

1.**Style Customization**: Players can collaborate with our art team to create a one-of-a-kind card art style based on their preferences.

2. **Skill Customization**: Players can propose their ideal skill concepts and work with our game-planning team to craft exclusive and powerful skills.

[b][Customization Rules][/b]

1. This service is exclusively for players who have reached VIP12 status through recharge.

2. The customization of special cards will be carried out in the order of players reaching VIP12 status. Players who reach VIP12 first will receive priority for customization services.

3. During the customization process, please communicate and negotiate with our official team to ensure that the final product meets the expectations of both parties.

4. Once customization is complete, the special cards will serve as an exclusive benefit for VIP12 players and cannot be transferred, sold, or traded in any other way.

[b][Application Process][/b]

1. Players who have reached VIP12 through recharge should contact us via official email to submit a customization request.

2. We will contact you within 5 working days after receiving your application to begin the customization process.

3. During customization, please communicate with our team and provide timely feedback and confirmation on the progress.

4.Upon completion of customization, we will distribute the cards in-game and notify you via email.

[b]PS: Players can join the official discord and send a private message to Operations Personnel to apply for customization.[/b]

[b]Official Discord Link: https://discord.gg/qWj4f7HtrN[/b]

Thank you for your support and understanding! We look forward to providing a one-of-a-kind card experience for every VIP12 player! If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us. Enjoy the game!

Best regards,

Kings Call Game Development Team

notes.title: Game Transfer Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players:

We are pleased to inform you that in order to meet the diverse needs of our players and provide a richer gaming experience, we are now launching a service to transfer player accounts [b][u]from the English version to the German version[/u][/b]. Please note that this transfer service will involve some important account information changes. Please read the following instructions carefully:

[b]1. **Transfer Content**:[/b]

* This transfer service will only include the player's VIP level and total amount of gold recharged on the account.
* Other game data, such as game progress, items, cards, equipment, etc., will not be transferred.
* Please make sure you have dealt with this information before deciding to transfer.

[b]2. **Original Account Handling**:[/b]

* After the transfer, the game account in the original game server will be deleted.
* Please make sure to back up all the necessary information and ensure that you no longer need the original account before submitting the transfer application.

[b]3. **Transfer Process Update**:[/b]

* Before submitting the transfer application, you need to create a new game account in the target server (where you wish to transfer).
* Click to switch to the registration interface, select the server after scrolling down, fill in the nickname of the new character that has already registered an account, click to register. If successful, you can see the operation result in the status interface. If you fill in the wrong information, click "Register" again to update.

[b]4. **Important Reminders**:[/b]

* Please make sure you fully understand and accept all the terms and conditions of this transfer service before submitting the transfer application.
* Once the transfer service is completed, it cannot be reversed or restored to its original state.
* Before proceeding with the transfer, please make sure to create a new game account in the target server as the transfer process will associate your VIP level and historical recharge gold coin information with this new account. If no account is created in advance, the transfer cannot be completed.

* Regarding duplicate registrations for character transfers: We do not allow multiple characters to be transferred to the same target character simultaneously. If duplicate registrations are detected, we will prioritize the transfer of the highest-level VIP to ensure fairness and reasonableness in the transfer process.

* Regarding the account ownership of transferred characters: Please ensure that all characters applied for transfer belong to the same Steam account. If the characters are scattered across different Steam accounts, unified transfer processing cannot be performed. Please carefully check and confirm the account ownership of all characters before submitting the transfer application.

* [b]We will provide a registration channel for account transfers on May 28, 2024 and will not accept transfer applications after that date. Please note.
[/b]
Please make sure you have read all of these terms and conditions before deciding to transfer.

notes.title: Announcement On Manually Sending Rewards For The May Day Tribute Event
notes.content:
Due to a bug in the reward collection method of the [b]May Day Tribute Event[/b], after carefully examining this issue and evaluating feasible solutions, we decided to take a more secure and direct way to handle it - [b]we will manually send rewards[/b].

We sincerely apologize to all players, as this change has undoubtedly caused additional waiting and inconvenience. Thank you for your understanding and support.

[b]We will send corresponding rewards after the event based on the corresponding cards received by players. Rewards will be sent in the form of email.[/b]

[b]Collect and own the card [Zeeva Stonebreaker] (Epic), reward: 200,000 Silver.
Collect and own the card [Zeeva Stonebreaker] (Legendary), reward: 500,000 Silver.
Collect and own the card [Zeeva Stonebreaker] (Godlike), reward: 1,000,000 Silver.
Collect and own the card [Zeeva Stonebreaker] (Awakened), reward: 2,000,000 Silver.
Collect and own the above FOUR cards at once, reward: Festival Pack*10.

Please note that only tearing the card pack (Festival Pack) in the Shop and combing or enhancing it in the Alchemy Lab will be valid in the event. Cards obtained before the event starts will be invalid to the event. It is necessary to reacquire the corresponding cards to participate in the event.[/b]

notes.title: New update to King’s Call rules
notes.content:
Score Boosting Rules:
Score Boosting is against the rules, if you are found to be score boosting the following will
apply:
The first offense, your score will be reset to zero, and you will be put on the wall of shame.
The second offense, your score will be reset to zero, and you will receive a 3 day ban.
The third offense, you will be permanently banned.
This does not apply to trading wins, but if one player is benefiting from raising their score in 1v1
or 2v2 either from their own alts or other players, action will be taken.
League Boosting rules:
Creating new accounts to claim league tickets and feeding yourself or others in a sealed league
is against the rules. Action will be taken if you are found to be doing so. This is a bannable
offense if abused.
Using Programs and Autoclickers to do bosses and other content for you:
The use of autoclickers and other such programs and scripts to complete bosses and other
content instead of clicking yourself is against the rules. This creates an unfair advantage as it is
possible to complete bosses while you are not at your computer and gain experience and items
you have not earned. This is a bannable offense if abused.
Harassment of other players:
If a player has asked you not to message them privately and you continue to do so, this
constitutes harassment. Please also refrain from using slurs and hate speech in the public chat,
as that is not acceptable. We have taken action for this and will continue to do so if abused.
Bug Abuse:
Deliberate bug abuse is against the rules. If you find a bug in the game please report it either
through the discord bug abuse channel, through the customer service email, or if deemed
serious enough, please private message one of the community managers.

notes.title: Game transfer announcement
notes.content:
1. **Transfer Content**:

* This transfer service will only include the player's VIP level and total amount of gold recharged on the account.
* Other game data, such as game progress, items, cards, equipment, etc., will not be transferred.
* Please make sure you have dealt with this information before deciding to transfer.

2. **Original Account Handling**:

* After the transfer, the game account in the original game server will be deleted.
* Please make sure to back up all the necessary information and ensure that you no longer need the original account before submitting the transfer application.

3. **Transfer Process Update**:

* Before submitting the transfer application, you need to create a new game account in the target server (where you wish to transfer).
* Click to switch to the registration interface, select the server after scrolling down, fill in the nickname of the new character that has already registered an account, click to register. If successful, you can see the operation result in the status interface. If you fill in the wrong information, click "Register" again to update.

4. **Important Reminders**:

* Please make sure you fully understand and accept all the terms and conditions of this transfer service before submitting the transfer application.
* Once the transfer service is completed, it cannot be reversed or restored to its original state.
* Before proceeding with the transfer, please make sure to create a new game account in the target server as the transfer process will associate your VIP level and historical recharge gold coin information with this new account. If no account is created in advance, the transfer cannot be completed.

* Regarding duplicate registrations for character transfers: We do not allow multiple characters to be transferred to the same target character simultaneously. If duplicate registrations are detected, we will prioritize the transfer of the highest-level VIP to ensure fairness and reasonableness in the transfer process.

* Regarding the account ownership of transferred characters: Please ensure that all characters applied for transfer belong to the same Steam account. If the characters are scattered across different Steam accounts, unified transfer processing cannot be performed. Please carefully check and confirm the account ownership of all characters before submitting the transfer application.

* The registration time for account transfers is from after maintenance on March 5th, 2024, to March 10th, 2024. Applications for transfers will not be accepted after this period. Please take note.

Please make sure you have read all of these terms and conditions before deciding to transfer

notes.title: Common and play Tournament
notes.content:
Tournament on January 19th 7pm server time pst on the north american server

Rules:

This is a 1v1 Common only tournament, no runes or equipment allowed. If you are found to use runes or any equipment (armor, helm, cloak, sword accessories etc.) you will be disqualified

Any player from the 3 english servers can play, but it will be hosted on the NA server.

You must build a deck containing only common cards. Please register through the official King’s Call discord (https://discord.gg/C3Wdg8Wj) and you will be put into a bracket randomly. This is a single elimination tournament. After your match please report the match results in the discord so the bracket can be updated. The tournament will be commentated by saint on his twitch at twitch.tv/isaintseer.

This tournament is great as anyone can play from Vip 0 all the way to Vip10 in a fair environment, so in theory the best players should win. 

First place reward is a godlike version of the card Tethys and the second place reward is a legendary version of the card Tethys
